nodes.description: owner: address of the contract owner defined in Ownable and used by the onlyOwner modifier
balances: mapping(address => uint256) holding token balance of every account (BasicToken)
allTokenHolders: address[] array of every address that ever received tokens, iterated in redistributeFees
percentQuotient: numerator of the transfer fee percentage, initialized to 3
percentDividend: denominator of the transfer fee percentage, initialized to 1000 and used as divisor
totalSupply: total amount of minted USDX tokens
allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of ERC20 allowances (StandardToken)
name: token name string (XITO)
symbol: token symbol string (USDX)
decimals: token decimals, fixed to 18
Ownable(): constructor that sets owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner function that changes the contract owner
transfer(address _to, uint256 _amount): public ERC20 transfer that deducts a fee and calls redistributeFees
balanceOf(address _owner): view function returning balances[_owner]
redistributeFees(uint tokensForOwner): internal fee distribution that loops over allTokenHolders
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _amount): allowance based transfer with fee
approve(address _spender, uint256 _amount): sets allowance for msg.sender
allowance(address _owner, address _spender): view returning remaining allowance
burn(uint256 _value): onlyOwner function destroying tokens and reducing totalSupply
function () public payable: fallback that immediately reverts any ether sent
XITOToken(address wallet): constructor minting totalSupply to wallet and setting token metadata and fee parameters
getTokenDetail(): view returning name, symbol and totalSupply
setFee(uint _percentQuotient, uint _percentDividend): onlyOwner function updating the fee fraction without validation
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances
Unchecked division of _amount by percentDividend in transfer/transferFrom; divisor can be zero
totalSupply.sub(balances[owner]) in redistributeFees can underflow if owner balance exceeds totalSupply
Unbounded for-loop over allTokenHolders in redistributeFees, gas/DoS risk for token holders
setFee stores an unvalidated percentDividend, allowing the fee divisor to be set to zero
_to parameter of transfer: destination address
_amount parameter of transfer: amount to transfer before fee
_owner parameter of balanceOf: address queried
tokensForOwner parameter of redistributeFees: fee amount to distribute
_from parameter of transferFrom: source address
_to parameter of transferFrom: destination address
_amount parameter of transferFrom: amount to transfer
_spender parameter of approve: allowance beneficiary
_amount parameter of approve: allowance value
_owner parameter of allowance: token owner
_spender parameter of allowance: spender
_value parameter of burn: amount of tokens to destroy
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership: new owner address
wallet parameter of XITOToken constructor: initial token holder
_percentQuotient parameter of setFee: new fee numerator
_percentDividend parameter of setFee: new fee denominator (potential zero divisor)
tokensForOwner local in transfer: fee computed as _amount * percentQuotient / percentDividend
tokensToBeSent local in transfer: _amount - tokensForOwner
thirtyPercent local in redistributeFees: 30% of collected fees sent to owner
seventyPercent local in redistributeFees: 70% of collected fees redistributed to holders
soldTokens local in redistributeFees: totalSupply.sub(balances[owner])
i loop index over allTokenHolders in redistributeFees
bal local in redistributeFees: cached holder balance
percentOfTotalSold local in redistributeFees: bal * 100 / soldTokens
tokensToBeTransferred local in redistributeFees: holder share of seventyPercent
tokensForOwner local in transferFrom: fee computed from _amount
tokensToBeSent local in transferFrom: _amount - tokensForOwner
